close_reason: Merged into KITH-q7et.5 (jmap structs now listed there)
description:
kith-jmap/src/lib.rs exposes several pub structs that serve as wire-format responses but have no #[non_exhaustive] attribute:

- CoreCapability (lines 105-114)
- KithChatCapability (lines 117-122)
- CidCapability (line 130)
- Capabilities (line 133-140)
- KithAccountCapability (line 145-147)
- AccountCapabilities (line 149-152)
- Account (lines 154-161)
- Session (lines 163-179)
- Dispatcher (line 347-350)

These structs' fields are all pub, meaning adding any field to CoreCapability or Session (e.g. a new RFC 8620 capability field) is a breaking change for any code that constructs them via struct literals. build_session() is the only provided constructor, but the struct fields are still pub, so external code can bypass it.

Fix: add #[non_exhaustive] to all of the above. Alternatively, make fields pub(crate) and rely solely on build_session() for external construction.
title: kith-jmap: Session and Capabilities structs pub without #[non_exhaustive]
